$comment: Curated 'hero' journeys captured as live demos (rrweb sessions) for docs.paged.media + the website. The capture pipeline (capture.ts) records each of these and uploads <id>.rrweb.json as a GitHub Release asset; docs/website pull them. Add an entry to amplify a journey publicly; the rest of the suite stays CI-gates-only. The journey path is relative to apps/canvas/tests/journey.
